summary_en: Taisei authorized acquisition of up to 2.30 million shares (1.41% of outstanding) for maximum 20.0 billion yen via market purchase from November 12, 2026 through March 31, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Taisei Corporation's board of directors authorized a new share buyback program. The company will acquire up to 2.30 million shares of its own common stock, representing 1.41% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum expenditure of 20.0 billion yen. Purchases will be executed via market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 12, 2026 through March 31, 2027. All shares acquired under this program are scheduled to be cancelled pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act.

The company cites shareholder returns and capital efficiency improvement as the objectives. This buyback is positioned within the company's fundamental policy of maintaining financial discipline while prioritizing growth investment, coupled with long-term stable dividends and flexible treasury stock acquisition. The authorization follows the mid-term management plan (2024–2026), under which Taisei has already implemented 150.0 billion yen in treasury stock acquisitions and cancellations funded by the reduction of policy-held stocks. The current program reflects progress in growth investments and the company's current cash position.
